text:
mira: Heads up — onboarding fennec-2b-quant-v2. Seeing intermittent OOMs when total context ~6k+ and batch > 2. Happens mostly when users request long continuations (max_new_tokens >= 1024). Logs point to sudden KV alloc spikes and then kernel OOM. Anyone seen this specific shape?

Darren: yep, saw something like that on a canary yesterday. Int4 path creates some temporary buffers for attention kernels that fragment after long sessions. Quick mitigation: lower default max_new_tokens and clamp batching.

kevin: stack snippet from the pod: 
```
I0312 14:22:11.123 OOM device=0 alloc=3355443200
kv_cache_reserved=2048MB current=1890MB -> try alloc 2700MB
prefetch=true, slot_compaction=false
```
If prefetch is on we saw prefetch + large `max_new_tokens` drive the sudden alloc. Disabling prefetch for this model reduced incidence in prod smoke.

sophia: Proposal for canary config (short, conservative):
```
{
  "max_new_tokens": "512",
  "batch_size": "2",
  "prefetch": "false",
  "slot_compaction": "true",
  "kv_trim_threshold": "0.7",
  "slowstart_fraction": "0.5"
}
```
This keeps latency reasonable but limits the long-tail memory churn. Also enable slot_compaction so the runtime reclaims fragments more aggressively.

mira: I'll kick off the canary with that config now — /deploy canary fennec-2b-quant-v2 config=fennec-conservative-0312. Will monitor memory, evictions, and p50/p95 latency for 30m. If anyone wants to tune the TTL or compaction thresholds shout now. @kevin @darren

inference-bot: Canary deployment started: fennec-2b-quant-v2 @ canary-3 — instances=4 — config=fennec-conservative-0312 — started_at=2026-03-12T14:31:05Z

Darren: If OOMs stop but p95 jumps we can try two levers: 1) adaptive_window=true (reduces prefetch horizon), 2) dynamic_batching: {soft_limit: 2, hard_limit: 4}. That usually limits mem tail without killing throughput.

sophia: Also adding a tiny eval run (200 prompts drawn from conv+longform slices) to guard against quantization regressions after we change defaults. If quality drops > 1.5 BLEU/ROUGE threshold we roll back.

mira: Thanks — I'll post the initial grafana links once warmup finishes. If the canary looks good we'll roll to a small cohort and bump batch to 3 for premium tenants only.

kevin: One more note: if we keep prefetch=false, add `kv_prefetch_on_demand=true` so short sessions don't pay the latency cost but long ones can gradually warm the cache.

sophia: ack. I'll update the rollout checklist: add memory surge alert (device_alloc_delta > 1GB in 60s) and an automatic rollback trigger for OOMs > 2 in 10m. :thumbsup:

mira: perfect — thanks team.
